substeps.caption: Six OpenFlexure microscopes on one aluminium sub-tray: four v7 and two Delta Stages, each standing in a 2 mm pocket cut to its own footprint, so it goes back in the same place.
A polished coupon on a slide goes under the clips of each microscope in the front row...

All six scan at once: each flexure stage rasters its coupon under the reflection optics, its legs leaning with it (+-6 mm on the v7s, +-4 mm on the Deltas). The v7s focus by moving the optics, the Deltas by moving the stage.
One hub supplies power and a network switch to all six through the cable ducts; the tray's own power feeds the hub.
The sub-tray lifts out as one unit by its two end handles: microscopes, slides and cables together.
And goes back into its place on tray D.
